mapper.select:
SELECT ao.id, -- 异常编号：使用ao.abnormal_code（业务字段），彻底区分orderCode ao.abnormal_code AS abnormalCode,
ol.id AS orderId, ao.order_code AS orderCode, ol.plate_no AS plateNo, cs.station_name AS stationName, ao.abnormal_type AS abnormalType, ao.abnormal_reason AS abnormalReason, -- 毫秒时间戳 = 秒 × 1000 UNIX_TIMESTAMP(ao.abnormal_time) * 1000 AS abnormalTime, ao.abnormal_status AS abnormalStatus,
-- 核实人：直接返回nickname，匹配VO的verifyUser su1.nickname AS verifyUser, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(ao.verify_time) * 1000 AS verifyTime, ao.verify_result AS verifyResult,
-- 处理人：直接返回nickname，匹配VO的handleUser su2.nickname AS handleUser, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(ao.handle_time) * 1000 AS handleTime,
su3.nickname AS checkUser,
UNIX_TIMESTAMP(ao.complete_time) * 1000 AS completeTime, ao.remark, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(ao.create_time) * 1000 AS createTime, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(ao.update_time) * 1000 AS updateTime
FROM abnormal_order ao LEFT JOIN order_list ol ON ao.order_code = ol.order_code COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci AND ol.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN charging_pile cp ON ol.pile_code = cp.pile_code COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci AND cp.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN charging_station cs ON cp.station_id = cs.id AND cs.deleted = 0
-- 核实人关联：统一排序规则，解决字符集冲突 LEFT JOIN sys_user su1 ON ao.verify_user = su1.id -- 处理人关联：统一排序规则，解决字符集冲突 LEFT JOIN sys_user su2 ON ao.handle_user = su2.id
LEFT JOIN sys_user su3 ON ao.check_user = su3.id
WHERE ao.deleted = 0
AND ao.abnormal_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{req.abnormalCode}, '%')
AND ao.order_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{req.orderCode}, '%')
AND ol.plate_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{req.plateNo}, '%')
AND ao.abnormal_type = #{req.abnormalType}
AND ao.abnormal_status = #{req.abnormalStatus}
AND ao.create_time >= #{req.startTime}
AND ao.create_time <= #{req.endTime}
